dataList.place:
Hongyuan's Laboratory, Past
过去，鸿园的实验室

dataList.content:
I am... I'm scared, please...
好……好可怕……

I am begging you, please... stop... no more...
求……求求你……就这样结束……

G-grandma...
奶、奶奶……

What... what is that sound? Why are they... why are these people crying? Why are they screaming?
这……是什么声音？为什么……我听到人们在哭喊？

Little Baoyu. Let me tell you a story of the olden times.
宝玉啊，在很久以前。

Many years ago, the Shi family used to reign over all of this land.
曾有一个史家凌驾于所有家族之上的时代。

Other families could hardly hold a candle to us, let alone meet us eye to eye.
其他家族甚至无法在史家面前抬起头来。

On days when my grandfather would grace Daguanyuan with his presence, no palanquins dared to move. And every servant in the house served him, and only him, exalting his very path.
我的祖父行于大观园之日，所有的轿子都不得行进。所有的下人都只能沿着他走过的道路侍立在后。

His words were absolute. He shaped the very landscape of Hongyuan with his every command.
无人能反驳他的话。遵从我祖父之命，鸿园彻底改变了。

What a travesty it is that they dare to presume what they have afforded me is generosity and compassion.
但如今那些人就像施恩于我一般，表现得一副慈悲为怀的样子，真是可悲啊。

Now... How is subject #4 responding?
那么……4号个体的反应如何？

Hemoptysis and severe internal organ damage has been observed. Its skin layers are entering status #17 as well.
检测到了咯血与部分内脏损伤。皮肤也进入了17号状态。

Mix reagent #3 and #8 at a fifty-fifty ratio, dehydrate it for one Earthly Branch hour, and inject it into subject #2.
那么，将3号原材料与8号原材料对半混合，干燥一个时辰后，为2号个体注射。

Do not forget to shuffle the ingredient labels randomly before numbering them.
完成这一过程后，要将材料重新随机混合后再次编号。

Understood, venerable Jia Mu.
明白，老太太。

An experiment to create the thirteenth branch of Heishou...
创造第十三支黑兽的实验……

I can hardly wait to see the results.
我也想快点见到其结果。

Now close the lids on all reagents.
现在，盖好所有材料的盖子。

I will now undo the blindfolds.
解开蒙眼布吧。

Open your eyes, little Baoyu.
来，睁开眼，宝玉啊。

But...
但……

But they're crying, like they're in so much pain...
能听到他们正痛苦地哭泣的声音……

Yes, they are. Which is why you must open your eyes.
是的。所以，你必须睁开双眼。

Forgive us...! Forgive us...!
请原谅我们……！请原谅我们吧……！

G-grandma, I'm scared...
我、我害怕，奶奶……

I don't wanna see this... You're... you're hurting them...
我不想看到这些……那些人都很痛苦……

Don't worry, little Baoyu, for they cannot bring you harm. They are things condemned to an eternity of pain. Whether you are afraid, whether you are sad, they will continue to suffer.
他们并非能对你造成伤害的存在。他们是无论你感到害怕还是悲伤，都会一直遭受着痛苦的存在，宝玉啊。

So, you must continue to witness them, child. Be sure to get a good look at them all.
所以你要做的，就是一直观望着他们。

But... I don't want to.
但是……我不想看。

I wanna go out to Daiyu... to Huan... and play.
我想去外面和黛玉……和阿环……一起玩。

A gem is useful only when it sits and glimmers wordlessly in its place, nothing more—for that is the worth inhered in its existence.
宝石只有在自己该在的位置上安静地发光，才能完成其使命。

We will be visiting here more often from now on, so familiarize yourself.
我们以后还会更常来的，你要继续将这些放在眼里。

Young master, did something happen? You look so pale!
少爷，发生什么事了吗？你的面色怎么那么苍白？
dataList.place:
Yihongyuan Interior, Past
过去，怡红院 内部

dataList.content:
You said you were going kiting with Miss Daiyu and young master Jia Huan today, right? Did Miss Daiyu's kite snap your string?
你说今天要和黛玉小姐和环少爷一起放风筝来着。黛玉小姐的风筝弄断了少爷你的风筝线吗？

Xiren...
袭人……

I... I saw something so... horrible there.
我……我在那里看到了非常可怕的东西……

There were people... in pain... People... crying. They kept crying for help, but no one would help them, and they only hurt them more...
人们一直在痛苦地嚎叫着……他们一直在求救，但却无人理睬……只是让他们更为痛苦……

What are you talking about, young master? What people, where?
你说什么，少爷？在哪儿，是什么人？

At the lab where... grandma brings me...
奶奶一直带我去的那个实验室……

I thought she was there to assist the Kong family with the creation of a new Bolus? Why would—
听说她去那个地方……是为了帮孔家做研制新丸的实验，可是为什么……

I don't know... Said they're gonna make a new Heishou... But I didn't get to see any experiments because they put something over my eyes, and they made me watch people cry...
我不知道……听说是为了制造新的黑兽……途中我的眼睛一直被蒙着……只听到人们的哭声……

... How could they.
……怎会如此。

Young master, have you shared this with anyone else?
少爷……除了我，你还和谁说过这些话？

Just you, Xiren... why?
我只对你讲过，袭人……怎么了？

... Then you mustn't speak about this with anyone else. Do you understand?
……那你之后对任何人都不能说这些话了。好吗？

Why? But I'm so scared...
为什么？我好害怕……

I don't wanna go there anymore...
我不想再去那里了……

Young master, I will see if there's anything I can do to help. Anything...
少爷，我去看看有没有什么我能帮上您的……

So please, hold on just a little longer...
所以，请再等一会儿……

Thinking back to it now...
现在回想起来……

Evaluation Arena Interior B1
评审场内部 地下1层

dataList.content:
I think Xiren was just as scared and lost as I was.
袭人也像我一样害怕、不知所措。

I should have known then that telling her wouldn't have changed anything. Too bad I didn't.
和她说这些话什么都改变不了，可惜的是，当时的我没有意识到。

But Xiren now...
但现在的袭人……

The Xiren in his memory was nothing like the Xiren we saw just a few hours ago.
记忆中的袭人与我们数小时前才见过的袭人截然不同。
Hong Lu called it... erosion. 鸿璐将其称为风化。

Xiren always worried so much about me. More than I did for myself.
袭人总是比我更担心我自己。

And when all the worry and anxiety became too much... I guess she decided to not feel anything at all.
但那些担忧逐渐膨胀……也许她最终选择了让自己不再有任何感受。

Because she would fit in much better in Daguanyuan as she is now.
不管怎么说，她以现在的样子在大观园继续生活下去，可能会更好。

I... miss the old Xiren.
我……怀念过去的袭人。

Though it seems that I am alone in that sentiment.
虽然好像怀念她过去那个样子的只有我自己。

So the thirteenth Heishou...
所以第十三支黑兽……
... must have been Jia Mu's real experiment. 是贾母本质上正在做的实验吗？

... Yes.
……是的。

She told me that the other experiment was the part of her 'sleight of hand'.
她告诉我她之前做的实验是一种障眼法。

So she was crafting two different Boluses at once, huh...
所以她同时在制作两种丸……

No one in Daguanyuan's as well-versed in crafting Boluses as grandmother is.
老太太精通丸的制作，大观园中无人能出其右。

But recipes for Boluses used to create the Heishou are really complicated and well-guarded to the point where no outsider ever learns of their recipe.
据说制造黑兽所用的丸制作起来非常复杂……其制作方法也经严格管理，外部人无权得知。

Even with her expertise, even with the support of the Kong family, creating a new branch of the Heishou Pack was an entirely different matter.
再怎么精通制作丸，即便是得到了孔家的支援……制造新的黑兽也完全是另一个层次的问题吧。

This brings us to question whether... it really was a thirteenth branch of the Heishou Pack she wanted to create.
所以……老太太想制造的真的是第十三支黑兽吗？
